page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-4-lssd is an arm64-based server instance belonging to the c4a server family. It features 4 dedicated virtual CPUs and 32.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include any graphics processing units and has no complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Local storage is not configured for this instance.

Operating on the arm64 architecture, this instance is designed for workloads requiring a higher memory footprint relative to compute resources. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention from other tenants. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the arm64 architecture typically offers a favorable performance-per-watt ratio, making this memory-optimized configuration suitable for memory-intensive tasks that do not require x86-specific instruction sets.

The c4a-highmem-4-lssd instance is suited for workloads such as medium-sized databases, in-memory caching layers, data buffering, and lightweight enterprise applications that benefit from a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio.
